bagPolicy.summary: Suitcases and bags over 10 litres cannot enter, even for locker storage. Handbags and shoulder bags of 10 litres or less may be inspected and accepted.
allowed: Handbag or shoulder bag up to 10 litres
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
